title: A-B-C Right Triangle Pattern
statement:
Write a function to generate a right-angled letter triangle pattern of height `n`.

Row `i` (0-indexed, from `0` to `n - 1`) should contain letters starting from `A` up to the `i`-th letter of the alphabet (A is index 0, B is 1, etc.) concatenated without spaces.

The rows should be separated by newline characters (`\n`). There should be no trailing spaces in any row, and no trailing newline at the end of the final row.

For example, if `n = 4`, the output should be:
```
A
AB
ABC
ABCD
```

editorial.approach: Run an outer loop `i` from `0` to `n - 1`. For each row `i`, build a string by appending characters from character code 65 (`A`) to `65 + i`. Join the rows with `\n`.

hints: Row `i` (0-indexed) lists letters starting from `A` up to the `i`-th letter.
ASCII code 65 corresponds to the character 'A'.
Convert character codes back to letters using `String.fromCharCode(65 + j)`.

bruteForceSolution.explanation: Loop `i` from `0` to `n - 1`. In the inner loop `j` from `0` to `i`, convert `65 + j` to a character and append it.

optimizedSolution.explanation: Maintain a running alphabet string, appending the next letter in sequence on each outer iteration, avoiding nested loops.

interviewExplanation: Each row simply appends the next uppercase letter in the alphabet. We start with `'A'` and append the character corresponding to `65 + i` on each row, allowing us to build the triangular output in linear string operations.
